summary: Lists software tools that can be used to test and evaluate TCP implementations, or that give specific results about how a TCP behaves. It is a pointer document for implementors who want to check their stack, not a protocol specification. It is informational.

eli5.summary: If you built a toy car, you would want ways to test how well it drives. This is a list of tools for testing how well a computer handles its internet conversations.

questions: what tools can test a tcp implementation
how do i test tcp implementations
